'''Central Sector Square''' was located within [[Central Sector]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Amma]] on [[Bacrana/Legends|Bacrana]]. It was the site of a fierce [[Amma protest|clash]] between demonstrators and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].
